hints.title: Block Boundaries
hints.text: Block k has size k. The first element of block k starts after k * (k - 1) // 2 total preceding elements.

hints.title: Product Modulo
hints.text: For each block k from 1 to m, compute the product of its k integers modulo 10^9 + 7.

hints.title: Sum over Blocks
hints.text: Accumulate the block products into a total sum modulo 10^9 + 7.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def sumOfProductBlocks(self, m: int) -> int:
        MOD = 1_000_000_007
        total_sum = 0
        cur = 1
        for k in range(1, m + 1):
            block_prod = 1
            for _ in range(k):
                block_prod = (block_prod * cur) % MOD
                cur += 1
            total_sum = (total_sum + block_prod) % MOD
        return total_sum
```

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Using large integers without intermediate modulo operations causes memory bloat and slow multiplication.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Expects understanding of block partition indexing and intermediate modular arithmetic.
